column1: # Committed out/ files that build.sh does NOT generate, and why.
# A file listed here is hand-maintained: out/ is its authority, no source
# regenerates it, and editing src/ will not change it. build.sh prints this
# list on every run so a green build is never read as "out/ is in sync".
# Every committed out/*.clj must appear here or in generated-targets.d/;
# build.sh fails when one appears in neither.

column2: hand-written babashka entrypoint (has its own shebang); no src/ source exists
